_about: Characters made with the Tripo API (see generate.mjs). style is added to every prompt so the cast matches. Up to 5 animations each (billed per animation). rigType: leave out to let rig-check decide. fromTask: reuse an existing model task (no new generation). rigModel: v3.0 (default, 11 presets) or v1.0 (biped only, 90+ presets prefixed preset:biped:). fromRig: add animations to an existing rig task. rig: false makes a prop (no rig, no animations); style replaces the roster style for it. young_*: the heroes remade younger (1.0, 26 Nov 2026): rig only, no animations; every clip is copied from the old hero with copy-clips.mjs.
